title: Stretcher path
summary: Whether a lying-flat ambulance stretcher can be carried from the entrance to each bedroom.

rules.text: A 24 in by 84 in (610 mm by 2134 mm) stretcher, kept flat, passes every door and corner from the entrance to each bedroom.
rules.standard: IBC 3002.4 (an elevator car must take an ambulance stretcher 24 in by 84 in, 610 by 2134 mm, flat); a size reference, not a code requirement for dwellings
